mapper.update: CREATE TABLE agent_runtime_budget_roots_policy_v2 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, scenario TEXT NOT NULL, source_version TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), active_limit_seconds INTEGER, closing_active_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (closing_active_seconds >= 0), closing_run_id TEXT, phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUSINESS' CHECK (phase IN ('BUSINESS','CLOSING')), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,root_id), UNIQUE (tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode), CHECK ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND active_limit_seconds IS NOT NULL AND active_limit_seconds>0) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND active_limit_seconds IS NULL)) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE agent_runtime_budget_runs_policy_v2 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('PRIMARY','MEMBER')), source_version TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), active_limit_seconds INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,run_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode) REFERENCES agent_runtime_budget_roots(tenant_id,root_id,policy_mode), CHECK ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND active_limit_seconds IS NOT NULL AND active_limit_seconds>0) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND active_limit_seconds IS NULL)) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE agent_runtime_budget_balances_policy_v2 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('ROOT','RUN','STAGE_BASE','STAGE','CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN')), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, dimension TEXT NOT NULL, policy_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (policy_mode IN ('ENFORCED','OBSERVE_ONLY')), maximum INTEGER CHECK (maximum >= 0), consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consumed >= 0), reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reserved >= 0), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,scope_kind,scope_id,dimension), CHECK ((scope_kind IN ('CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN') AND maximum IS NOT NULL) OR (scope_kind NOT IN ('CLOSING','CLOSING_RUN') AND ((policy_mode='ENFORCED' AND maximum IS NOT NULL) OR (policy_mode='OBSERVE_ONLY' AND maximum IS NULL)))) ) STRICT
ALTER TABLE agent_runtime_budget_roots_policy_v2 RENAME TO agent_runtime_budget_roots
ALTER TABLE agent_runtime_budget_runs_policy_v2 RENAME TO agent_runtime_budget_runs
ALTER TABLE agent_runtime_budget_balances_policy_v2 RENAME TO agent_runtime_budget_balances
